findsmith-app-title: Browser title for FindSmith, a tool to find and replace text on Wikimedia projects.
findsmith-nav-main-menu: Accessible label for the primary navigation menu.
findsmith-nav-home: Navigation link to the home page.
findsmith-nav-projects: Navigation link to the signed-in user's projects.
findsmith-nav-add-wiki: Navigation link to the screen for registering a Wikimedia wiki with the tool.
findsmith-nav-help: Inactive navigation item for future help.
findsmith-footer-development: Footer notice that the tool is still being developed.
findsmith-footer-license: Label preceding the project's software license.
findsmith-language-label: Label for the interface language selector.
findsmith-request-failed: Fallback error shown when a request fails without a usable error message, including in the project workspace.
findsmith-home-title: Name of the tool. Do not translate FindSmith.
findsmith-home-lead: Introductory description on the home page. AutoWikiBrowser is a software name and should not be translated.
findsmith-home-development-title: Heading for a notice on the home page.
findsmith-home-development-message: Home-page notice warning that the tool is under development.
findsmith-home-account: Heading of the Wikimedia sign-in panel.
findsmith-home-checking-session: Status shown while checking if the visitor is signed in.
findsmith-signed-in-as: Shown on the home page and projects page. $1 is the signed-in Wikimedia username. Example values: $1 = “ExampleUser”.
findsmith-home-logout: Link to sign out of Wikimedia OAuth in FindSmith.
findsmith-home-login-description: Description of Wikimedia sign-in and how credentials are handled.
findsmith-home-login: Button to begin Wikimedia OAuth sign-in.
findsmith-workspace-title: Title and heading of the user's project workspace.
findsmith-workspace-loading: Status shown while loading the project workspace.
findsmith-workspace-empty: Shown when the user has no projects.
findsmith-workspace-new: Heading of the form to create a new project.
findsmith-workspace-name: Label for the project's name field.
findsmith-workspace-wiki: Label for the wiki selection field.
findsmith-workspace-no-wikis: Shown when no Wikimedia wikis have been registered with FindSmith.
findsmith-workspace-add-wiki: Link to the Add Wiki screen.
findsmith-workspace-create-error: Fallback error when creating a project fails.
findsmith-add-wiki-description: Explanation on the Add Wiki page. AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON is the name of a wiki configuration page.
findsmith-add-wiki-domain: Label for the Wikimedia wiki domain field.
findsmith-add-wiki-checking: Progress label on the Add Wiki button.
findsmith-add-wiki-added: Heading above the list of registered Wikimedia wikis.
findsmith-project-select-a-page-to-rende: Empty-state instruction in rendered preview before a queue page is selected.
findsmith-project-awb-access-warning: Warning on a project when the signed-in account is absent from that wiki's AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON authorization lists. Keep CheckPageJSON, enabledusers, and enabledbots as page and JSON field names.
findsmith-project-view-checkpagejson: Link from the project access warning to the wiki's AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON page; keep CheckPageJSON as the page name.
findsmith-project-page-sources-and-filte: Expandable heading above the source types and namespace filters used to build the page queue.
findsmith-project-source: Label for the dropdown that selects which page-source type to add.
findsmith-project-add-source: Button in page sources that adds another source row to the current project.
findsmith-project-move-item-up: Accessible name for an arrow button that moves a source, queued page, or rule up. $1 is the item label. Example values: $1 = “Help:Example”.
findsmith-project-move-item-down: Accessible name for an arrow button that moves a source, queued page, or rule down. $1 is the item label. Example values: $1 = “Help:Example”.
findsmith-project-remove-item: Accessible name for an X button that removes a source, queued page, or project rule. $1 is the item label. Example values: $1 = “Help:Example”.
findsmith-project-add-a-source-to-build-: Empty-state guidance in the page-source pane when no source has been configured.
findsmith-project-namespaces: Fieldset heading for wiki namespaces included in page-list generation.
findsmith-project-maximum-pages: Label for the maximum number of pages to load into this project’s queue.
findsmith-project-build-page-list: Button that generates a project page queue from the configured sources and namespace filters.
findsmith-project-cancel-generation: Button that cancels an in-progress build of the page queue.
findsmith-project-list-tools: Expandable heading for queue filtering, sorting, comparison, and CSV export controls.
findsmith-project-find-title: Label for the queue tool that filters page titles.
findsmith-project-status: Label for the queue status filter and review progress status.
findsmith-project-all-statuses: Queue status filter option that includes pages in every status.
findsmith-project-pending: Queue page status for a page awaiting review; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-reviewed: Queue page status for a page already reviewed; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-saved: Queue page status for a page saved to Wikimedia; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-skipped: Queue page status for a page explicitly skipped; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-missing: Queue page status when Wikimedia did not return the requested page; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-invalid: Queue page status when the page cannot be reviewed; also a status-filter option.
findsmith-project-sort-by-title: Queue tool that sorts the remaining page titles alphabetically.
findsmith-project-export-csv: Queue tool button that downloads the current page queue as CSV.
findsmith-project-compare-with-titles: Label for a textarea where the user pastes page titles to compare with the queue.
findsmith-project-show-differences: Expandable heading for titles present only in the pasted list or only in the queue.
findsmith-project-only-in-pasted-list: Heading for titles in the pasted comparison list but absent from the project queue.
findsmith-project-only-in-queue: Heading for titles in the project queue but absent from the pasted comparison list.
findsmith-project-clear-queue: Queue tool that removes all pages from the current queue.
findsmith-project-rules: Tab heading for the project rule editor.
findsmith-project-options: Inactive future tab in the project workspace; it currently has no settings.
findsmith-project-stop-pre-parse: Button that stops the scan of queued pages before review.
findsmith-project-previous: Review button that moves to the previous queued page.
findsmith-project-skip: Review button that marks the current page as skipped.
findsmith-project-stop-review: Review button that pauses the review while retaining progress.
findsmith-project-next: Review button that records the current page decision and moves forward without saving to Wikimedia.
findsmith-project-shortcuts-when-no-fiel: Keyboard shortcut hint below review controls. Keep N, P, and S as the actual shortcut keys.
findsmith-project-also-skip-pages-whose-: Pre-parse option that also compares Wikimedia-rendered output; the scan is slower when enabled.
findsmith-project-pre-parse-queue: Button that starts scanning queued pages for changes before review.
findsmith-project-resume-review: Button that continues a previously stopped review.
findsmith-project-save-to-wikimedia: Fieldset heading around edit summary, edit flags, and the Save action for one reviewed page.
findsmith-project-edit-summary: Label for the Wikimedia edit summary field shown before Save.
findsmith-project-i-will-follow-this-wik: Checkbox acknowledgement required before saving edits in the current wiki review.
findsmith-project-minor-edit: Checkbox that marks a Wikimedia edit as minor.
findsmith-project-bot-edit: Checkbox for a Wikimedia edit marked as a bot edit; availability depends on user rights.
findsmith-project-save: Button that submits the reviewed wikitext of one page to Wikimedia.
findsmith-project-next-records-the-revie: Review guidance explaining that Next records a decision but does not save a Wikimedia edit.
findsmith-project-name: Label for the optional name of one project rule.
findsmith-project-operation: Label for the dropdown that selects a rule operation.
findsmith-project-find-and-replace: Rule-operation choice for replacing matching text in wikitext.
findsmith-project-append-wikitext: Rule-operation choice for adding wikitext at the end of a page.
findsmith-project-prepend-wikitext: Rule-operation choice for adding wikitext at the beginning of a page.
findsmith-project-add-category: Rule-operation choice for adding a category link to a page.
findsmith-project-remove-category: Rule-operation choice for removing a category link from a page.
findsmith-project-replace-category: Rule-operation choice for exchanging one category link for another.
findsmith-project-rename-template: Rule-operation choice for changing a template name in page wikitext.
findsmith-project-set-template-parameter: Rule-operation choice for setting a named template parameter.
findsmith-project-remove-template-parame: Rule-operation choice for removing a named template parameter.
findsmith-project-conditional-group: Expandable heading for settings shared by project rules in one conditional group.
findsmith-project-rules-with-the-same-gr: Help text for conditional rule groups; the condition is checked against original page text.
findsmith-project-group-name: Label for the name shared by rules with one conditional group.
findsmith-project-page-must-contain: Label for text that must occur in the original page before a rule group applies.
findsmith-project-invert-condition: Rule-group checkbox that reverses a condition on the original page text.
findsmith-project-parameter-name: Label for a template parameter targeted by a template rule.
findsmith-project-leave-empty-to-delete-: Small explanatory note in the FindSmith project and review workspace.
findsmith-project-regex: Rule option that treats Find as a regular expression.
findsmith-project-case-sensitive: Rule option that makes matching letter case significant.
findsmith-project-replace-all: Rule option that replaces every match instead of only the first.
findsmith-project-multiline: Regular-expression option that changes how start and end anchors match lines.
findsmith-project-dot-matches-newline: Regular-expression option allowing the dot metacharacter to match line breaks.
findsmith-project-protect-wikitext-regio: Expandable heading for rule masks that prevent matches inside selected wikitext structures.
findsmith-project-skip-a-match-if-it-ove: Help text for masking wikitext regions from a find-and-replace rule.
findsmith-project-apply-to-all-matching-: Template-rule option that affects every matching template on a page.
findsmith-project-save-to-my-rules: Button that stores a named rule in the user’s reusable rule library.
findsmith-project-add-rule: Button that adds a new editable rule to the project.
findsmith-project-my-saved-rules: Fieldset heading for the user’s reusable named rules.
findsmith-project-add-to-project: Button beside a saved rule that copies it into this project.
findsmith-project-delete: Button beside a saved rule that deletes it from the user’s reusable library.
findsmith-project-name-a-rule-and-save-i: Empty-state guidance in the reusable rule library.
findsmith-project-configuration-changed-: Warning after project settings change while a review exists; Apply rules starts a fresh review.
findsmith-project-delete-project: Destructive button that deletes the current user-owned project.
findsmith-project-review-progress: Fieldset heading for counters of pending, reviewed, saved, skipped, and unavailable pages.
findsmith-project-saved-to-wiki: Review progress count of pages successfully edited on Wikimedia.
findsmith-project-unavailable: Review progress count of queued pages that cannot be reviewed.
findsmith-project-decision-history: Fieldset heading for recorded per-page review decisions.
findsmith-project-no-decisions-recorded-: Empty-state text in the review decision history.
findsmith-project-history: Inactive future tab beside Review in the page pane.
findsmith-project-what-links-here: Inactive future tab for incoming wiki links to the current page.
findsmith-project-logs: Inactive future tab for logs related to the current wiki page.
findsmith-project-typos: Inactive future tab for typo suggestions on the current wiki page.
findsmith-project-recompute-diff: Button that recalculates the diff after manual edits to proposed wikitext.
findsmith-project-diff: Tab that shows the difference between current and proposed wikitext.
findsmith-project-preview: Tab or button that displays the Wikimedia-rendered proposed page.
findsmith-project-unified-diff: Expandable heading for the one-column line diff shown below the side-by-side diff.
findsmith-project-no-diff-the-proposed-w: Review diff empty state when the edited text equals the current wiki revision.
findsmith-project-page-title: Label for the title field used to preview rules on one wiki page.
findsmith-project-no-diff-the-rules-did-: Standalone preview diff empty state when no configured rule changes the selected page.
findsmith-project-build-a-page-list-to-b: Empty-state guidance before any queue or standalone page preview is loaded.
findsmith-project-append: Button that appends typed titles to the review page queue.
findsmith-project-make-list: Heading of the panel that builds a list of wiki pages.
findsmith-project-pages-count: Page count in the list panel. $1 is the number of pages. Adapt the PLURAL forms to the target language. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-project-shown-count: Queue filter count. $1 is the visible count; $2 is the total count. Example values: $1 = “2”, $2 = “10”.
findsmith-project-comparison-count: Comparison results. $1, $2 and $3 are counts of page titles. Example values: $1 = “2”, $2 = “3”, $3 = “4”.
findsmith-project-preparse-progress: Progress during pre-parsing. $1 is the current page number and $2 is the total page count that controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “2”, $2 = “10”.
findsmith-project-summary-length: Edit summary length indicator. $1 is the current character count. Example values: $1 = “42”.
findsmith-project-rule-count: Rule result count. $1 is rule number and $2 is match count. Example values: $1 = “1”, $2 = “3”.
findsmith-project-rule-number: Default name for an unnamed rule. $1 is its one-based number. Example values: $1 = “1”.
findsmith-project-rule-kind-category: Short label for a category operation in a rule heading.
findsmith-project-rule-kind-template: Short label for a template operation in a rule heading.
findsmith-project-rule-kind-text: Short label for a text operation in a rule heading.
findsmith-project-history-replacements: Decision history count. $1 is the number of replacements. Keep the {{PLURAL:$1|one=…|other=…}} form and adapt the categories to the target language. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-project-result-in-flight: Decision history edit result while a request may still be in progress.
findsmith-project-result-authentication: Decision history result when Wikimedia rejects an edit due to missing or expired authentication.
findsmith-project-result-permission: Decision history result when the account lacks permission to edit the page.
findsmith-project-result-block: Decision history result when Wikimedia blocks the account from editing.
findsmith-project-result-protection: Decision history result when page protection prevents the edit.
findsmith-project-result-captcha: Decision history result when Wikimedia requires a CAPTCHA for the edit.
findsmith-project-result-spam: Decision history result when Wikimedia’s spam filter rejects the edit.
findsmith-project-result-conflict: Decision history result when another edit changed the page first.
findsmith-project-result-maxlag: Decision history result when the wiki is too busy to accept the edit now.
findsmith-project-result-abuse-filter: Decision history result when an AbuseFilter rule blocks the edit.
findsmith-project-result-unknown: Decision history result when Wikimedia rejects the edit for an unclassified reason.
findsmith-project-operations-count: Preview operation count. $1 is the number of operations and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-project-revision: Page revision identifier. $1 is a revision number. Example values: $1 = “123456”.
findsmith-project-namespace-short: Short label for namespace number. $1 is the namespace ID. Example values: $1 = “0”.
findsmith-project-protection: Page protection information. $1 is the protection status. Example values: $1 = “None”.
findsmith-project-config-subtitle: Project workspace subtitle. $1 is the wiki ID and $2 is the saved configuration version. Example values: $1 = “enwiki”, $2 = “3”.
findsmith-project-review-subtitle: Review subtitle. $1 is current page position, $2 total pages, $3 pending, $4 reviewed, and $5 skipped. Example values: $1 = “2”, $2 = “10”, $3 = “7”, $4 = “2”, $5 = “1”.
findsmith-project-groups: Wikimedia account groups on the selected wiki. $1 is a comma-separated list or a status. Example values: $1 = “user, autoconfirmed”.
findsmith-project-none-reported: Shown when Wikimedia reports no user groups.
findsmith-project-unavailable-lower: Status shown when Wikimedia user groups could not be loaded.
findsmith-project-loading-lower: Status shown while Wikimedia user groups load.
findsmith-project-preparse-stale: Notice above a stale rendered preview.
findsmith-project-rendered-by-wiki: Notice above a current rendered preview.
findsmith-project-rendering: Progress label for the preview refresh button.
findsmith-project-refresh-preview: Button to render or rerender the proposed wiki page.
findsmith-project-rendering-preview: Status displayed while a rendered preview loads.
findsmith-project-click-refresh-preview: Instruction in the empty rendered preview area.
findsmith-project-access-error: Access verification error. $1 is the underlying error message. Example values: $1 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-project-editable: Status showing that the page can be edited.
findsmith-project-not-editable: Status showing that the page cannot be edited.
findsmith-project-current-revision: Fallback page heading for current wiki revision.
findsmith-project-proposed-changes: Page heading when rules propose changes.
findsmith-project-no-proposed-changes: Page heading when rules make no changes.
findsmith-project-proposed-wikitext: Accordion title for the transformed wiki text.
findsmith-project-proposed-wikitext-modi: Accordion title after manual changes to proposed wiki text.
findsmith-project-page: Page type indicator in preview metadata.
findsmith-project-redirect: Redirect type indicator in preview metadata.
findsmith-project-no-reviewable-page: Empty-state message in the review panel.
findsmith-project-apply-rules: Button to save changes to project rules and refresh the review.
findsmith-project-review: Tab heading for the page review area.
findsmith-project-source-username-placeh: Placeholder for a list of Wikimedia usernames.
findsmith-project-source-value-placehold: Placeholder for a page source value list.
findsmith-project-filter-placeholder: Placeholder for the queue title filter.
findsmith-project-compare-placeholder: Placeholder for the queue comparison field.
findsmith-project-rule-name-placeholder: Placeholder for an optional rule name.
findsmith-project-optional-placeholder: Placeholder for an optional condition group name.
findsmith-project-example-page-placehold: Placeholder for the preview page title.
findsmith-project-append-titles-placehol: Placeholder for the queue append field.
findsmith-project-find: Label for the text to find in a rule.
findsmith-project-template-name: Label for the template to match in a rule.
findsmith-project-category-to-find: Label for the category to match in a rule.
findsmith-project-replace-with: Label for replacement text in a rule.
findsmith-project-wikitext: Label for wikitext to append or prepend.
findsmith-project-parameter-value: Label for a template parameter value.
findsmith-project-loading-project: Loading state while the project workspace is fetched.
findsmith-project-source-manual: Page source option for manually entered titles.
findsmith-project-source-category: Page source option for members of a wiki category.
findsmith-project-source-backlinks: Page source option for pages linking to a selected page.
findsmith-project-source-transclusions: Page source option for pages transcluding a selected template.
findsmith-project-source-search: Page source option for a wiki search.
findsmith-project-source-watchlist: Page source option and API summary for the signed-in user's Wikimedia watchlist.
findsmith-project-source-contributions: Page source option for a user's contributions.
findsmith-project-source-links-on-page: Page source option for links found on a page.
findsmith-project-source-categories-on-p: Page source option for categories found on a page.
findsmith-project-source-redirects-to-pa: Page source option for redirects to a page.
findsmith-project-mask-comments: Rule option to protect HTML comments from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-tags: Rule option to protect wiki tags from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-references: Rule option to protect references from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-links: Rule option to protect links from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-headings: Rule option to protect headings from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-templates: Rule option to protect templates from replacement.
findsmith-project-mask-link-targets: Rule option to protect link targets from replacement.
findsmith-project-error-awb-check: Project warning when FindSmith cannot verify this user’s AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON authorization.
findsmith-project-error-saved-rules-load: Error box shown when the user’s reusable rule library cannot load.
findsmith-project-error-groups-load: Error box shown when Wikimedia account groups cannot load for this project wiki.
findsmith-project-error-preparse: Error box shown when scanning queued pages before review fails.
findsmith-project-confirm-discard-manual: Confirmation before applying project rules when the user has manually edited proposed wikitext; those manual changes would be lost.
findsmith-project-busy-saving-rule: Progress label while a reusable rule is being saved.
findsmith-project-busy-deleting-rule: Progress label while a reusable rule is being deleted.
findsmith-project-error-deleting-rule: Error box shown when deletion of a reusable rule fails.
findsmith-project-busy-deleting: Progress label while the current project is being deleted.
findsmith-project-error-deleting-project: Error box shown when deletion of the current project fails.
findsmith-project-error-review-action: Error box shown when a review navigation or decision action fails.
findsmith-project-busy-saving-edit: Progress label while one reviewed page is being saved to Wikimedia.
findsmith-project-error-saving-edit: Error box shown after a failed Wikimedia save; instructs the user to reload review state.
findsmith-project-busy-recomputing: Progress label while the diff for manually edited wikitext is recalculated.
findsmith-project-error-recomputing: Error box shown when the diff cannot be recomputed after manual wikitext changes.
findsmith-project-error-queue-action: Error box shown when a page queue action fails.
findsmith-project-busy-building: Progress label while the project page queue is being generated.
findsmith-project-busy-applying-rules: Progress label while changed project rules are applied to a new review.
findsmith-project-busy-saving: Progress label while project settings are being saved.
findsmith-project-busy-loading-preview: Progress label while a page preview is loaded from Wikimedia.
findsmith-project-confirm-clear-queue: Confirmation before removing all pages from the current project queue.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-not-revie: Reason the Save button is disabled for a page that cannot be saved again in this review.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-no-change: Reason the Save button is disabled when proposed and current wikitext match.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-summary-r: Reason the Save button is disabled when the edit summary is empty.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-summary-l: Reason the Save button is disabled when the edit summary plus required attribution exceeds 500 characters.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-attributi: Save guidance explaining that the mandatory Findsmith edit-summary attribution is appended automatically.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-recompute: Reason the Save button is disabled until the diff is recomputed after editing proposed wikitext.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-policies: Reason the Save button is disabled until the user acknowledges this wiki’s policies for the new review.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-page-righ: Reason the Save button is disabled because MediaWiki says the current page cannot be edited.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-rights-un: Reason the Save button is disabled because the user’s wiki edit rights could not be checked.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-awb-list: Reason the Save button is disabled because the user is absent from the wiki’s AutoWikiBrowser enabled list.
findsmith-project-save-blocker-awb-check: Reason the Save button is disabled because the AutoWikiBrowser authorization check failed.
findsmith-project-confirm-delete-saved-r: Confirmation before deleting a reusable rule. $1 is the rule name. Example values: $1 = “Fix categories”.
findsmith-project-confirm-delete-named-p: Confirmation before permanently deleting a project. $1 is the project name. Example values: $1 = “My project”.
findsmith-preview-frame-title: Accessible title of an iframe containing a rendered wiki page. $1 is the page title. Example values: $1 = “Help:Example”.
findsmith-edit-summary-autoreplacement: Fallback edit summary before the required Findsmith attribution.
findsmith-edit-summary-with-attribution: Complete edit summary sent to Wikimedia and shown below the editable summary field. $1 is the user-editable summary; $2 is the required, non-translatable wiki link to Findsmith help page. Translators may reorder the parameters but must retain both.
findsmith-edit-summary-replacement: Suggested edit summary for a text replacement. $1 is the text to find; $2 is its replacement. Example values: $1 = “old text”, $2 = “new text”.
findsmith-edit-summary-removed: Placeholder in a suggested edit summary when replacement text is empty.
findsmith-edit-summary-empty: Placeholder in a suggested edit summary when a template parameter value is empty.
findsmith-edit-summary-append: Suggested edit summary when wikitext is appended.
findsmith-edit-summary-prepend: Suggested edit summary when wikitext is prepended.
findsmith-edit-summary-category-add: Suggested edit summary when adding a category. $1 is the category name. Example values: $1 = “Example”.
findsmith-edit-summary-category-remove: Suggested edit summary when removing a category. $1 is the category name. Example values: $1 = “Example”.
findsmith-edit-summary-category-replace: Suggested edit summary when replacing a category. $1 is the old category name; $2 is the new name. Example values: $1 = “Old”, $2 = “New”.
findsmith-edit-summary-template-rename: Suggested edit summary when renaming a template. $1 is the old template name; $2 is the new name. Example values: $1 = “OldTemplate”, $2 = “NewTemplate”.
findsmith-edit-summary-parameter-set: Suggested edit summary when setting a template parameter. $1 is the parameter name, $2 is the template name, and $3 is the value. Example values: $1 = “date”, $2 = “Infobox”, $3 = “2026”.
findsmith-edit-summary-parameter-remove: Suggested edit summary when removing a template parameter. $1 is the parameter name and $2 is the template name. Example values: $1 = “date”, $2 = “Infobox”.
findsmith-api-structural-input-too-large: Error when input wikitext exceeds the size limit for structural rules.
findsmith-api-structural-output-too-larg: Error when transformed wikitext exceeds the output size limit.
findsmith-api-structural-too-many-replac: Error when structural rules exceed the replacement count limit.
findsmith-api-parsoid-endpoint-unsupport: Error when the selected Wikimedia wiki does not provide a supported Parsoid REST endpoint.
findsmith-api-parsoid-connect: Error when connecting to Parsoid fails. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “HTTP 503”.
findsmith-api-parsoid-parse: Error when Parsoid cannot parse wikitext. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “invalid wikitext”.
findsmith-api-parsoid-inspect-templates: Error when Parsoid cannot inspect templates. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-parsoid-serialize: Error when Parsoid cannot serialize wikitext. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “serialization failed”.
findsmith-api-preparse-transformation-fa: Reason shown for a failed pre-parse transformation. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “invalid regex”.
findsmith-api-transformation-failed: Reason shown when applying rules to a review page fails. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “invalid regex”.
findsmith-api-page-load-failed: Reason shown when a review page cannot be loaded. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “page not found”.
findsmith-api-rule-limit: Rule validation error returned by the API. $1 is the maximum number of rules and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “100”.
findsmith-api-rule-find-required: Rule validation detail when the Find field is missing. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-value-required: Rule validation detail when a required operation value is missing. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-category-invalid: Rule validation detail when a category name is malformed. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-group-incomplete: Rule validation detail when a conditional group lacks its name or text condition. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-group-conflict: Rule validation detail when a rule’s condition differs from others in its group. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-template-invalid: Rule validation detail when a template or parameter name is malformed. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-template-parsoid-requ: Rule validation error when a selected wiki does not offer the Parsoid service needed for template rules.
findsmith-api-rule-find-too-large: Rule validation detail when Find text exceeds its size limit. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-replacement-too-large: Rule validation detail when replacement text exceeds its size limit. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-regex-invalid: Rule validation error. $1 is the one-based rule number; $2 is the regex parser error. Example values: $1 = “2”, $2 = “unclosed group”.
findsmith-api-rule-replacement-limit: Rule validation error returned by the API. $1 is the maximum number of replacements and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “100000”.
findsmith-api-source-entry-limit: Page-source validation error. $1 is the source label; $2 is the maximum number of entries and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “Manual titles”, $2 = “500”.
findsmith-api-generation-preparing: Review queue status while page sources are being prepared.
findsmith-api-generation-ready-count: Review queue status after generation. $1 is the number of pages and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “10”.
findsmith-api-generation-init-failed: Page-list generation error. $1 is the underlying MediaWiki error. Example values: $1 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-generation-loading-manual: Page-list status while manual titles are loading.
findsmith-api-generation-loaded-manual: Page-list status after manual titles load. $1 is the number of titles and controls the PLURAL form. Example values: $1 = “10”.
findsmith-api-generation-manual-failed: Page-list error for manual titles. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “invalid title”.
findsmith-api-generation-loading-source: Page-list status while a source loads. $1 is the source type; $2 is its value. Example values: $1 = “category members”, $2 = “Category:Example”.
findsmith-api-generation-loaded-source: Page-list status after a source loads. $1 is the source type; $2 is its value. Example values: $1 = “category members”, $2 = “Category:Example”.
findsmith-api-generation-source-failed: Page-list error. $1 is the source type; $2 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “category members”, $2 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-source-category-members: Page-list generation label for wiki pages found in a category.
findsmith-api-source-backlinks: Page-list generation label for wiki pages linking to a selected page.
findsmith-api-source-transclusions: Page-list generation label for wiki pages transcluding a selected template or page.
findsmith-api-source-search-results: Page-list generation label for wiki search matches.
findsmith-api-source-watchlist-pages: Page-list generation label for pages from the user’s wiki watchlist.
findsmith-api-source-contribution-pages: Page-list generation label for pages in a user’s wiki contributions.
findsmith-api-source-linked-pages: Page-list generation label for outgoing links on a selected wiki page.
findsmith-api-source-categories-on-page: Page-list generation label for categories attached to a selected wiki page.
findsmith-api-source-redirect-pages: Page-list generation label for redirect pages targeting a selected wiki page.
findsmith-api-source-appended-pages: Source label used in the maximum-entry validation error when adding titles to a page list.
findsmith-api-summary-required: Edit-summary validation error before saving a page.
findsmith-api-summary-attribution-automa: Edit-summary validation error. The Findsmith attribution link is appended automatically.
findsmith-api-summary-one-line: Edit-summary validation error for line breaks.
findsmith-api-summary-max-length: Edit-summary validation error. 500 is the fixed character limit including attribution.
findsmith-api-save-awb-access: Reason saving stops when the account is not approved by the wiki's AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON or its access cannot be verified.
findsmith-api-save-rights-unverified: Reason saving stops when local edit permissions cannot be checked.
findsmith-api-save-account-blocked: Reason saving stops when the account is blocked on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-save-new-messages: Reason saving stops when the account has unread new messages on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-save-rights-missing: Reason saving stops when the account lacks read or edit rights on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-save-flags-denied: Reason saving stops when the selected minor or bot edit flag is unavailable.
findsmith-api-save-reload-page: Reason saving stops when the page cannot be loaded. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “page not found”.
findsmith-api-save-revision-changed: Reason saving stops when the page revision changed after review.
findsmith-api-save-page-protected: Reason saving stops when the current account cannot edit the page.
findsmith-api-save-bot-excluded: Reason saving stops when the page has a bots or nobots template excluding automated edits. Keep template names unchanged.
findsmith-api-save-bot-check-failed: Reason saving stops when bot-exclusion templates cannot be checked.
findsmith-api-save-outcome-ambiguous: Reason recorded when the edit outcome is unknown after a request to MediaWiki.
findsmith-api-save-conflict: Reason recorded after a MediaWiki edit conflict.
findsmith-api-save-abuse-filter: Reason recorded after an abuse-filter warning or block.
findsmith-api-save-rejected: Reason recorded after MediaWiki rejects an edit. $1 is the edit failure kind. Example values: $1 = “permission”.
findsmith-api-preparse-page-load-failed: Reason shown when a page cannot be loaded during pre-parsing. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-page-title-required: Page-loading error for an empty page title.
findsmith-api-page-title-invalid: Page-loading error for an invalid page title without a detailed reason.
findsmith-api-page-title-invalid-reason: Page-loading error for an invalid page title. $1 is the MediaWiki reason. Example values: $1 = “invalid title”.
findsmith-api-page-revision-missing: Page-loading error when no readable revision exists.
findsmith-api-page-content-missing: Page-loading error when wikitext content cannot be read.
findsmith-api-page-model-unsupported: Page-loading error for an unsupported content model. $1 is the model name. Example values: $1 = “Scribunto”.
findsmith-api-sources-incomplete: Validation error when submitted page-source fields have different lengths.
findsmith-api-sources-limit: Validation error when a project has more than 100 page sources.
findsmith-api-source-type-unsupported: Validation error for an unsupported page-source type.
findsmith-api-namespace-id-invalid: Validation error for a malformed namespace ID. $1 is the submitted value. Example values: $1 = “abc”.
findsmith-api-rules-incomplete: Validation error when submitted rule fields have different lengths.
findsmith-api-rule-name-too-long: Validation error for a rule name. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-operation-invalid: Validation error for a rule operation. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-type-invalid: Validation error for a rule type. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-case-invalid: Validation error for a rule case option. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-scope-invalid: Validation error for a rule replacement scope. $1 is the one-based rule number. Example values: $1 = “2”.
findsmith-api-rule-index-invalid: Validation error for a malformed rule index.
findsmith-api-rule-index-range: Validation error for a rule index outside the submitted rule list.
findsmith-api-endpoint-not-found: Error title for an unknown API endpoint.
findsmith-api-endpoint-not-found-message: Error detail for an unknown API endpoint.
findsmith-api-wiki-title-missing: Page-list reason when MediaWiki does not return a requested title.
findsmith-api-protection-until: Page protection label. $1 is the protection kind, $2 is the level, and $3 is the expiry. Example values: $1 = “edit”, $2 = “sysop”, $3 = “2027-01-01”.
findsmith-api-acknowledge-the-selected-w: Save validation detail when the user has not acknowledged the selected wiki's editing policies for this review.
findsmith-api-add-at-least-one-page-sour: Project validation detail when the user tries to build a page list without any source.
findsmith-api-an-edit-request-may-have-r: Save failure detail when Wikimedia may have received an edit but FindSmith cannot confirm the outcome. Warn against retrying the same job.
findsmith-api-an-unexpected-error-occurr: Fallback detail for an unclassified server error in an API response.
findsmith-api-cancel-generation-or-wait-: Queue-action detail when page-list generation is still running.
findsmith-api-cannot-append-pages: Short API error title for a failed attempt to append titles to the page queue.
findsmith-api-cannot-pre-parse: Short API error title for a failed pre-parse of queued pages.
findsmith-api-cannot-resume-review: Short API error title when a stopped review cannot be resumed.
findsmith-api-cannot-save: Short API error title when saving an edit to Wikimedia is not allowed or fails.
findsmith-api-cannot-select-page: Short API error title when the requested queue page cannot be selected.
findsmith-api-cannot-start-review: Short API error title when a review cannot start from the current project and queue.
findsmith-api-check-the-wiki-page-and-bu: Safety instruction after an edit with an uncertain outcome or a wiki policy warning; the user must inspect the wiki page before continuing.
findsmith-api-checkpagejson-has-no-reada: Add Wiki validation detail when the AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON page has no readable revision. Keep CheckPageJSON as a page name.
findsmith-api-checkpagejson-must-be-prot: Add Wiki validation detail when AutoWikiBrowser CheckPageJSON is not protected from non-admin edits. Keep CheckPageJSON as a page name.
findsmith-api-checkpagejson-must-contain: Add Wiki validation detail when CheckPageJSON lacks the required enabledusers or enabledbots JSON arrays. Keep these field names unchanged.
findsmith-api-checkpagejson-must-use-the: Add Wiki validation detail when CheckPageJSON does not have MediaWiki's JSON content model. Keep CheckPageJSON as a page name.
findsmith-api-choose-previous-skip-stop-: Review-action validation detail listing the accepted action names. The names correspond to review controls.
findsmith-api-choose-a-different-name-fo: Project creation detail after the submitted project name conflicts with an existing project.
findsmith-api-choose-a-page-in-the-curre: Page-selection detail when the user requests a title outside the finished queue or selects a page while generation runs.
findsmith-api-choose-select-append-move-: Queue-action validation detail listing the accepted queue operations.
findsmith-api-confirm-that-you-want-to-p: Project deletion validation detail when the required confirmation is missing.
findsmith-api-could-not-add-wiki: Error title when registering a wiki fails; also used as a fallback in the Add Wiki error box.
findsmith-api-could-not-append-pages: Short API error title when an append-pages request fails after validation.
findsmith-api-could-not-delete-rule: Short API error title when deleting a saved rule from the user's rule library fails.
findsmith-api-could-not-render-preview: Error title when Wikimedia cannot render the proposed page; also used as a fallback in the preview error box.
findsmith-api-could-not-save-rule: Error title when saving a rule to the user's library fails; also used as a fallback in the rule-library error box.
findsmith-api-deletion-not-confirmed: Short API error title when a project deletion request lacks explicit confirmation.
findsmith-api-edit-blocked: Short save error title when wiki policy or permissions prevent the proposed edit.
findsmith-api-edit-outcome-unknown: Short save error title when Wikimedia may have received the edit but its result cannot be determined.
findsmith-api-enter-a-wikimedia-wiki-dom: Add Wiki form validation detail. en.wikipedia.org is an example domain; keep the domain unchanged.
findsmith-api-enter-at-least-one-page-ti: Manual page-source validation detail when no page title was supplied.
findsmith-api-invalid-language: Short API error title when the requested interface language code is malformed.
findsmith-api-invalid-namespaces: Short project validation error title for malformed or unsupported namespace selections.
findsmith-api-invalid-page-sources: Short project validation error title for malformed page-source fields.
findsmith-api-invalid-preview: Short preview error title when the submitted page title or preview data is invalid.
findsmith-api-invalid-project-name: Short project validation error title when its name is empty, too long, or malformed.
findsmith-api-invalid-queue-action: Short API error title when a queue operation name or its parameters are invalid.
findsmith-api-invalid-queue-limit: Short project validation error title when the maximum page count is outside the allowed range.
findsmith-api-invalid-replacement-rules: Short project validation error title when one or more replacement rules are invalid.
findsmith-api-invalid-review-action: Short API error title when a review control action is unknown or invalid.
findsmith-api-invalid-rule: Short rule-library error title when a saved rule cannot pass validation.
findsmith-api-language-not-available: Short API error title when a requested interface language has no bundled catalog.
findsmith-api-no-changes: Short save error title when the proposed wikitext is identical to the current wiki revision.
findsmith-api-no-pages-to-append: Short queue error title when an append request contains no usable page titles.
findsmith-api-no-translation-catalog-exi: Translation endpoint error detail when a valid requested language has no bundled catalog.
findsmith-api-only-wikimedia-project-dom: Add Wiki validation detail rejecting a domain outside Wikimedia projects.
findsmith-api-only-a-stopped-review-with: Resume-review validation detail describing the required stopped state and saved page queue.
findsmith-api-policy-acknowledgement-req: Short save error title when the current review has no acknowledgement of wiki editing policies.
findsmith-api-pre-parse-is-running: Review status while the backend scans queued pages for rule changes before review.
findsmith-api-pre-parse-stopped: Review status after the pre-parse scan was stopped by the user.
findsmith-api-project-changed-elsewhere: Short conflict error title when the submitted project version is older than the stored version.
findsmith-api-project-name-already-exist: Short project creation error title when this user already has a project with the submitted name.
findsmith-api-project-name-must-contain-: Project name validation detail; 1 and 255 are character limits.
findsmith-api-project-not-found: Short API error title when a project ID is missing or inaccessible to the user.
findsmith-api-project-autowikibrowser-ch: Add Wiki validation detail when the required Project:AutoWikiBrowser/CheckPageJSON page is absent. Keep the page title unchanged.
findsmith-api-queue-is-still-building: Short API error title when the page queue has not finished generation.
findsmith-api-queue-locked: Short API error title when queue operations are blocked by an active review or generation.
findsmith-api-reload-the-page-and-try-ag: Conflict recovery detail after stale page state is rejected before changing data.
findsmith-api-reload-the-project-to-get-: Project version conflict detail telling the user to reload before reapplying edits.
findsmith-api-reload-the-review-to-get-t: Review progress conflict detail telling the user to reload before another action.
findsmith-api-request-could-not-be-verif: Security error detail when a state-changing API request fails CSRF verification.
findsmith-api-resume-the-review-before-n: Page-navigation detail when the review is stopped and must be resumed first.
findsmith-api-review-changed-elsewhere: Short conflict error title when review progress changed since this page loaded.
findsmith-api-review-is-busy: Short API error title when another review operation is currently running.
findsmith-api-review-is-paused: Short API error title when a review cannot accept the requested action in its paused state.
findsmith-api-review-not-found: Short API error title when a review ID is missing or inaccessible to the user.
findsmith-api-review-stopped: Review status after the user stops the review; its progress remains stored.
findsmith-api-rule-data-is-invalid: Rule-library validation detail when the submitted saved rule has malformed settings.
findsmith-api-rule-name-must-contain-bet: Saved-rule name validation detail; 1 and 255 are character limits.
findsmith-api-rules-changed-review-every: Review warning after project rules change; each queued page must be reviewed against its latest wiki revision.
findsmith-api-saved-rule-not-found: Short rule-library error title when a saved rule ID is missing or belongs to another user.
findsmith-api-saved-rule-unavailable: Error detail when the saved rule does not exist or belongs to another user.
findsmith-api-saved-rules-unavailable: Short API error title when the user's saved rule library cannot be loaded.
findsmith-api-select-a-pending-or-review: Page-selection validation detail describing which queue statuses may be opened.
findsmith-api-select-at-most-50-namespac: Project namespace validation detail; 50 is the maximum number of selected namespaces.
findsmith-api-select-namespaces-availabl: Project namespace validation detail when a selected namespace ID does not exist on the chosen wiki.
findsmith-api-select-one-of-the-availabl: Project creation validation detail when the submitted wiki is not in FindSmith's supported wiki list.
findsmith-api-start-or-resume-a-review-f: Review-action validation detail when no active review is available for the requested action.
findsmith-api-start-pre-parse-before-sca: Pre-parse validation detail when a scan operation is requested before pre-parse starts.
findsmith-api-stop-pre-parse-before-chan: Queue-action validation detail while the pre-parse scan is still running.
findsmith-api-stop-pre-parse-before-revi: Review-action validation detail while the pre-parse scan is still running.
findsmith-api-the-checkpagejson-page-was: Add Wiki validation detail when the wiki API did not return the requested CheckPageJSON page.
findsmith-api-the-proposed-wikitext-is-t: Save validation detail when the edited wiki source exceeds FindSmith's size limit.
findsmith-api-the-proposed-wikitext-matc: Save validation detail when there is no difference between edited text and the current wiki revision.
findsmith-api-the-requested-page-does-no: Preview or review detail when the requested wiki page title has no page.
findsmith-api-the-reviewed-text-base-rev: Save request validation detail; the edited text, base revision, and edit start time must accompany the request.
findsmith-api-the-title-wiki-or-proposed: Preview or save validation detail when a page title, wiki identifier, or edited text is malformed.
findsmith-api-this-interface-language-is: Language preference validation detail when a well-formed language code has no bundled catalog yet.
findsmith-api-this-job-encountered-a-wik: Review recovery detail after a wiki policy warning; the user must resolve it on the wiki before a new review.
findsmith-api-this-job-is-paused-after-a: Review recovery detail after an uncertain edit attempt; inspect the wiki page before a new review.
findsmith-api-this-project-does-not-exis: Project loading error detail when the project ID is absent or owned by another account.
findsmith-api-this-review-does-not-exist: Review loading error detail when the review ID is absent or owned by another account.
findsmith-api-this-review-uses-a-configu: Review loading error detail when stored review settings use a newer or unsupported format.
findsmith-api-this-wiki-did-not-return-a: Add Wiki validation detail when the wiki API omits its ID or namespace metadata.
findsmith-api-this-wiki-is-already-in-th: Add Wiki validation detail when this Wikimedia project has already been registered.
findsmith-api-unexpected-error: Short API error title for an unclassified server failure.
findsmith-api-unknown-language: Short translation API error title for an unrecognized language code.
findsmith-api-unsupported-review-configu: Short review loading error title when saved review settings cannot be decoded by this release.
findsmith-api-unsupported-wiki: Short Add Wiki error title when the domain is not a supported Wikimedia project.
findsmith-api-use-a-valid-language-code: Language preference validation detail when the submitted language code is malformed.
findsmith-api-wait-for-list-generation-o: Project rule validation detail while page-list generation or pre-parse is active.
findsmith-api-source-more: Summary of a page source list. $1 is the first title, and $2 is the number of additional titles. Example values: $1 = “Help:Example”, $2 = “2”.
findsmith-api-queue-ready: Generation status after the page queue is ready.
findsmith-api-queue-generation-cancelled: Generation status after queue building is cancelled.
findsmith-api-queue-cleared: Generation status after the page queue is cleared.
findsmith-api-building-queue: Review job status while the page queue is building.
findsmith-api-active: Review job status while reviewing is active.
findsmith-api-stopped: Review job status after reviewing is stopped.
findsmith-api-cancelled: Review job status after reviewing is cancelled.
findsmith-api-failed: Review job status after an error.
findsmith-api-complete: Review job status after reviewing is complete.
findsmith-api-access-rights-unverified: Reason saving a reviewed page is disabled when wiki edit permissions cannot be checked.
findsmith-api-account-blocked: Reason saving is disabled when the Wikimedia account is blocked on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-new-messages: Reason saving is disabled when the Wikimedia account has unread new messages on the selected wiki.
findsmith-api-edit-rights-missing: Reason saving is disabled when the Wikimedia account lacks wiki read or edit rights.
findsmith-api-preparse-no-changes: Reason a page is skipped during pre-parsing because the rules make no changes.
findsmith-api-preparse-same-render: Reason a page is skipped during pre-parsing because the rendered output is unchanged.
findsmith-api-manual-skip: Reason recorded when a user skips a page during manual review.
findsmith-api-edit-outcome-unknown-reaso: Reason recorded while waiting for Wikimedia's response to an edit request.
findsmith-api-groups-unsupported: API error when user groups are requested for an unsupported wiki. $1 is the wiki identifier. Example values: $1 = “enwiki”.
findsmith-api-groups-load: API error when loading user groups fails. $1 is the wiki identifier and $2 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “enwiki”, $2 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-wiki-connect-error: API error while contacting a Wikimedia wiki. $1 is the underlying connection error. Example values: $1 = “request timed out”.
findsmith-api-wiki-info-error: API error while reading a Wikimedia wiki's metadata. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “invalid response”.
findsmith-api-mediawiki-request-error: API error after a MediaWiki request fails. $1 is the underlying error. Example values: $1 = “HTTP 503”.
findsmith-api-namespace-range: Validation error for an invalid namespace ID. $1 is the namespace number. Example values: $1 = “999999”.
findsmith-api-queue-limit-range: Validation error for the maximum page count. $1 is the maximum allowed count. Example values: $1 = “500”.
